Tara (Support): Escalating P1 — PebbleMart trial experiencing 429s on embedding ingest since 12:04 UTC, onboarding pipeline failing. Demo scheduled 17:00 local.
Ibrahim (CSM): Acknowledged. How severe? Demo blocked?
Tara (Support): Yes, imports failing. Example log: 2026-06-12T12:03:58Z ERROR ingest tenant=pebblemart status=429 quota_remaining=0
Marco (SRE): I'm seeing retry storms and KV prefix churn for that tenant. I can apply a temporary quota lift on their dedicated shard and enable server-sent backpressure headers to slow retries.
Nadia (CS Ops): Do it. Also we need a 3-line comms note: apology, immediate mitigation, request to pause retries, and pledge a post-mortem. Customer expects update by 15:00 UTC.
Ibrahim (CSM): Include an ask to schedule a 10-min pre-demo sanity call at 16:40 local. Also mark account as renewal-watch; they are a mid-sized pilot with expansion potential.
Tara (Support): Draft: "Hi Jordan — quick update: we identified transient rate limits that caused embed imports to fail. We've applied a temporary quota increase and enabled backpressure headers; errors have declined. Please pause automated retries for 45 minutes while we stabilize. We are prioritizing your demo and will reach out to schedule a 10-minute pre-demo check at 16:40 local. A post-mortem will follow within 24 hours. — Tara, Support (Redwood)"
Ibrahim (CSM): Add final sentence: "We apologize for the disruption and appreciate your patience."
Marco (SRE): Applied +30% quota to redwood-ded-6 for pebblemart and enabled backpressure. 429 rate down in the last 2 minutes. Creating INC-2026-055-07.
AlertBot: Incident INC-2026-055-07 created and assigned to Marco.
Nadia (CS Ops): Action items: Ibrahim send customer note by 14:50 UTC; Marco collect KV churn diffs and capture peak concurrency; Tara update KB with retry best-practices; CS Ops to tag account renewal-watch and ping Solutions Eng for post-demo enablement.
Ibrahim (CSM): Sending now. Pasting for review: "Hi Jordan — quick update: we identified transient rate limits that caused your embed imports to fail. We've applied a temporary quota increase and enabled backpressure headers; errors have declined. Please pause automated retries for 45 minutes while we stabilize. We are prioritizing your demo and will reach out to schedule a 10-minute pre-demo check at 16:40 local. A post-mortem will follow within 24 hours. We apologize for the disruption and appreciate your patience. — Ibrahim, CSM (Redwood)"
Tara (Support): LGTM :thumbsup:
Marco (SRE): Monitoring. If errors recur I will escalate to runtime on-call and consider traffic shaping at the LB.
Nadia (CS Ops): Noted. I'll update account health and set renewal-risk tag. Ibrahim, please confirm when customer responds.
Ibrahim (CSM): Sent and scheduled pre-demo check. Will update thread after customer confirmation. Thanks team :pray:
Tara (Support): Marking escalated->CS priority; closing initial loop until further updates.
